Majority of maize is grown under rainfed (70%) and irigated (30%)with majority in Kharif (80%) followed by Rabi (15%) and 5% in Summer seasons. Normally yellow / orange grain maize is grown mainly for feed (60%), food (17%) and pharmaceutical and industrial purposes (13%) in the state. Specialty com like sweet com, popcormand baby com arealso groWICOnsiderably in an area of 10,000-12,000 ha covering 6 to 8% of the total maize area in the state. During the year 2023-24, South Interior Karnataka recorded 27, 31 and 80% deficit rainfall during Kharif 2023, Rabi 2023 and summer 2024 respectively. Further the state as whole received 25, 38, 34% deficit rainfall respectively. Hence, there was considerable reduction in the productivity during both Kharif and Rabi seasons due to severe drought and adverse weather conditions.
